# js-yaml

The Install Builder vendors js-yaml 4.1.0 for YAML site-file import so that
public pages make no third-party requests. `../js-yaml.min.js` is the
unchanged browser distribution from
<https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/js-yaml/4.1.0/js-yaml.min.js>.
Its SHA-512 base64 digest matches the previous page's integrity attribute:

```text
CSBhVREyzHAjAFfBlIBakjoRUKp5h7VSweP0InR/pAJyptH7peuhCsqAI/snV+TwZmXZqoUklpXp6R6wMnYf5Q==
```
